name: com.mjgame.nmd.nkl.20
description:
Core framework dung chung cho game mobile Unity. Save theo DataModule tu 3.0.0 (xem Documentation~/Data.md). Bao gom UI, Save, Pool, StateMachine, Audio, Camera, Joystick, Indicator, Trigger, Extensions va Editor Tools.

DOTween can duoc import rieng. Sau khi import, mo Tools > Demigiant > DOTween Utility Panel va Create ASMDEF de tao DOTween.Modules.asmdef.

release.notes: 3.1.0: FSM API, AIBehaviour renamed FSMBehaviour (old name obsolete), StateMachine.Owner (Add/SetState/IsState, lazy machine, State<TOwner>, FSMBehaviour, safe nested ToState). 3.0: Save rebuilt on DataModule<T>: each data block is its own class saved under data_<snake_name>, accessed via T.Current. SaveBase keeps lifecycle + events only.
newFeatures: DataModule<T> save blocks (lazy load, auto save/delete)
